taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: iOS pasteboard data classification and intended sharing lifetime
controls.source_trace: Determine whether protected app data is deliberately copied and which audience/lifetime policy applies, including local-only and expiration choices.
controls.implementation_branch: Identify general versus named pasteboard, local-only/expiration settings and the recipient access behavior of the tested iOS version. A paste permission prompt or user-initiated paste changes the threat model. Show a synthetic classified value reachable by the specified unintended recipient; copying a deliberately shared value is expected functionality.
controls.controlled_verification: Use owned test apps/device or a source fixture with synthetic values; compare intended user copy and an unexpected background copy path.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: User-requested copying is not automatically a leak, and a paste permission prompt alone does not prove another app obtained data.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Limit unintended writes/sharing lifetime and verify legitimate copy/paste behavior under the supported OS.
